Nina Park: FYI Helios QBR scheduled Thurs 5/2 10am PT. Need a 1-page exec brief + 3 prioritized asks by EOD Tue.
Ethan Moore: Pulling onboarding status now. Current health: yellow. Trial seats active but daily API calls down ~28% since schema update.
Priya Desai: I can draft the one-pager. Will include adoption sparkline + one customer quote from last check-in. ETA Tue noon.
Liam O'Connor: Ops saw a config rollback last week that affected ingestion. Ill add a 2-line RCA + fix plan.
Nina Park: For asks, prefer: 1) short commercial (pay-for-success pilot), 2) operational (1-hr SLA window for ingest), 3) enablement (two training sessions). Keep them crisp.
Ethan Moore: For commercial ask, suggest a 3-month performance credit tied to usage recovery. Priya — want the exact phrasing?
Priya Desai: Yes please. Also want the quote: "reduced ETL time, but pipelines unstable after schema switch" — might be better as balanced feedback.
ops-bot: Incident summary Helios-prod: 03/11 schema regression, 03/19 config rollback. Avg MTTR 37m.
Liam O'Connor: Mitigation: staged schema rollout + post-deploy canary. Proposed timeline in appendix.
Nina Park: Slide plan: slide 1 — executive snapshot, slide 2 — onboarding & adoption, slide 3 — incidents & mitigations, slide 4 — asks, appendix — metrics + customer feedback.
Ethan Moore: Action: Ill export daily usage chart and churn projection. Due Mon 5pm PT.
Priya Desai: Action: Draft one-pager + quote placement. Due Tue 12pm PT.
Liam O'Connor: Action: Add incident timeline + SLO change draft. Due Tue 3pm PT.
Nina Park: Well run a dry-run Wed 5/1 4pm PT. Please upload to the shared drive before the dry-run.
finance-bot: Reminder: any credit proposal > $5k requires finance review and approval window of 2 business days.
Ethan Moore: Flag: Helios has two seats in pilot that are near expiration. If we propose credit, legal needs terms attachment. Ill open a ticket.
Priya Desai: Quick poll: do we include a customer success scorecard slide? Vote yes/no.
Nina Park: Yes — short scoreboard only (NPS, DAU, time-to-first-success).
Priya Desai: Uploaded draft to Drive -> https://drive.google.com/helios-qbr-draft (will add images after Ethan posts charts).
Liam O'Connor: Also capturing post-QBR enablement ask: two half-day workshops focused on pipeline stability and onboarding flows. Will scope resources.
Ethan Moore: Ill add callouts for top 3 adoption blockers (data mapping, auth keys rotation, missing sample data).
Nina Park: Great. After dry-run well lock the asks and route to finance/legal. Priya, keep the asks to single-sentence bullets.
Priya Desai: Will do. Also adding a one-line "risk window" note for execs: renewal - at-risk if usage < 70% by end of quarter.
Nina Park: Thanks team :pray: — please stick to deadlines so we can get executive sign-off and the Helios team clarity on next steps.
